target_customer: Mobile app teams (founders, product, QA and engineering leaders) and coding agents needing device verification
problem: Mobile bugs hurt ratings and checkout conversion, and QA does not scale with AI-accelerated coding. Teams trade speed against quality.
business_model: B2B SaaS and managed testing (AI agents plus optional human testers)
product_category: AI mobile app QA and testing

founders.name: Shivam Agrawal
founders.background_notes: About five years at Google building AI products and visual interfaces; led Android XR 3D system UI per YC page

founders.name: Aaron Yu
founders.background_notes: Google tech lead on Android XR, Stadia and Quick Share for about 5.5 years

competitors.name: UiPath Test Cloud
competitors.what: Enterprise test automation with Autopilot for Testers and agent features

competitors.name: Katalon TrueTest
competitors.what: AI-native test system that observes real user sessions and generates flows

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents must drive real apps and devices reliably like a human tester using vision-language models, with flakiness and device infrastructure as the hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Built on commodity models, and many startups and incumbents launched AI QA agents in 2025, so copying is fast.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent QA vendors shipped agentic features during 2025; no acquisition of QualGent found.

market_need_then: AI coding tools were speeding up shipping in 2025 so verification became the bottleneck; founders cite their experience with quality versus speed at Google.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct, short punchy lines; central message 'speed does not equal trust'

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launches in 2025 including a top-3 ranking claimed by aggregators; no evidence of fan community

brand_strength.rationale: Clear compound name hinting at quality plus agent, but little press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: QualGent joined YC in Spring 2025, launched on Product Hunt, expanded into a closed-loop QA platform with TrustLoop and DevLoop, and was still publishing in 2026. Funding is unclear and the QA agent space is crowded, so its position remains unproven.
notes: VCBacked lists a 500K pre-seed from June 2025 and Everydev mentions Leonis Capital; both aggregators disagree on dates, so not recorded as a round. The About page names backers Y Combinator, Leonis Capital, Shanda Capital, Darwin Ventures, Epsilon Ventures and Amino Capital, without amounts. Competitor entries come from a spring 2025 roundup. Completeness pass: the $500K pre-seed of Jun 2025 rests on VCBacked (single database); the company About page names Leonis Capital and others without amounts, so investors beyond YC are not attached to this round.
